scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ff/shared && npm run build -w @ff/database
scripts.predev: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages
scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API,WORKER -c auto "npm run dev -w @ff/web" "npm run dev -w @ff/api" "npm run dev -w @ff/worker"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @ff/api && npm run build -w @ff/worker && npm run build -w @ff/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ff/web && npm run lint -w @ff/api && npm run lint -w @ff/worker
